subjects: US index/sector breadth snapshot (S&P/Nasdaq/Russell levels, basket moves)

mis_merges.why: Brazil's crash is independently and fully surfaced by the dedicated 13-card 'brazil fiscal reform brl positioning' label, so an editor would still pick the theme; the merge adds noise and scatters evidence but doesn't cause a miss.

mis_merges.label: rbnz aud cpi preview
subjects: RBNZ (New Zealand) rate-path forecast and meeting outcome
Australian CPI print and RBA commentary
mis_merges.why: Both are peripheral antipodean macro items unlikely to be picked as a lead theme on a day dominated by FOMC/AI-capex/Brazil, so conflating the two countries doesn't change which themes the editor selects.

mis_merges.label: hedge fund leverage positioning
subjects: Fundamental hedge fund equity gross/net leverage levels (GS)
CTA systematic positioning in duration, FX and credit (UBS)
mis_merges.why: Both are thin data-point color with no standout narrative; merging different fund types under one label doesn't risk losing a lead theme since neither was a likely pick on its own.

notes: misc holds 12 cards (~1% of 1189), mostly legitimate singleton overflow (Microsoft buyouts, China high-tech GDP share, prediction-market volumes, a wealth-concentration stat) plus two Apple and two Brazil cards that duplicate content already carried by the dedicated 'apple earnings preview' and 'brazil fiscal reform brl positioning' labels.
